Frequently asked

How does character consistency work?+

You pick or upload a character once. We hold its features, outfit and rendering style as fixed inputs for every slide in the set, so slide eight looks like slide one instead of a cousin of it.

Is there an AI watermark on the output?+

No. Exports are clean images with no badge, corner mark or metadata stamp. What you download is what you post.

Which platforms does it export for?+

TikTok photo mode, Instagram carousels and YouTube community posts. Each export is sized and safe-area-checked per platform, so captions and UI never cover your text.

How do the monthly limits work?+

One slideshow of up to ten slides counts as one. Regenerating a single slide is free, and unused slideshows roll over for one month. Limits reset on your billing date.

Is my output unique to me?+

Yes. Layout, crop, palette and hook variation are seeded to your account, so two creators entering the same topic get different sets.
